summary: Occurrence data by period and environment are large for all four groups except tube worms (PBDB: gastropods 170,691, ammonoids 94,568, foraminifera 196,776), and shell form data are open for gastropods (176 shells in a CC0 Dryad set) and foraminifera (75 MorphoSource media), but no dataset parameterises coiling across gastropods, cephalopods, foraminifera and tube worms on one protocol and none ties shell form to age and environment.
next_step: Decide which coiling parameterisation will be used, then compile it per taxon from published shell parameters (gastropod Dryad set, ammonoid literature, foraminiferal tests) and join to PBDB occurrence age and environment by genus.
obstacles_confirmed: No common measurement protocol across the four groups exists in a repository.
Tube-worm shells are absent from MorphoSource (Serpulidae and Spirorbis returned 0) and thin in PBDB.
Occurrence and shell-form data are in different databases and must be linked at genus level.
